text:
The extremal number for a linear 3‑uniform hypergraph on \(n\) vertices that contains no (not necessarily induced) copy of the linear path \(P_{5}\) is  

\[
\boxed{\operatorname{ex}_{L}(n,P_{5})=\frac{n-1}{2}}\qquad\text{for all }n\text{ with }11\mid n .
\]

**Answer:** \(\displaystyle \mathrm{ex}_L(n,P_5)=\frac{n-1}{2}\) (when \(11\) divides \(n\)).
